data.body:
[P2] Enforce the final size bound when retained fields cannot fit

`Truncation.truncateRecord` is best effort and never removes or shortens the execution error. With `new LambdaLogExporter(1_000_000)`, an execution error message containing 300,000 backslashes fits the previous bare-record format at roughly 600 KB, but the new envelope exceeds 1.2 MB. This second pass retains that error and still prints the oversized line, exceeding both the configured budget and the documented event limit. Check the final serialized size and provide a bounded fallback for oversized retained fields, with a truncation marker. Add coverage using an execution error rather than removable input.
